hero.title: Tell us what is happening. We route it to the right responders.
hero.subtitle: Write or speak in English, Telugu, Tamil or Hindi. Add photos if you can. Your report is assessed in seconds and sent only to the services it needs.
hero.label: What is happening?

report.title: Report an emergency
report.describeHint: Say what you see, how many people are involved, and anything dangerous like fire, gas or water.
report.placeholder: Example: A car hit a bike at the signal. One person is bleeding. Petrol is leaking.
report.voiceListening: Listening… speak clearly. Background noise can cause mistakes.
report.voiceReview: Check the text above before sending.
report.voiceUnsupported: Voice input is not available in this browser. Please type your report.
report.voiceFailed: Could not turn your voice into text. Please type your report.
report.photosHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to {{mb}} MB each, at most {{max}} photos. Location data is removed from photos.
report.photoType: {{name}} is not a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.
report.photoLimit: You can add at most {{max}} photos.
report.locationDenied: Location permission was denied. Type a landmark or tap the map.
report.locationUnavailable: Your location could not be found. Type a landmark or tap the map.
report.locationTextPlaceholder: Example: Near Guindy bus stop, Anna Salai
report.locationMapHint: Tap the map to correct the location.
report.categoryHint: Skip this if you are not sure. We understand your description.
report.submitFailed: Your report was not sent: {{reason}}. Try again, or call 112.
report.offline: You are offline. Your report has not been sent. Call 112.
report.privacy: Your report goes only to the emergency services it needs. Photos are reviewed for the emergency, not to identify people.
report.needText: Describe the emergency in a few words.
report.addressFound: Address filled in from the map. Add a landmark or correct it if needed.

result.keepToken: Keep this page or this tracking code. You need it to check your report.
result.noConfirmed: No confirmed emergency detected from your description. If you need help, add more detail or call 112.
result.locUnverified: Location not confirmed. Responders may call you or ask for a landmark.
result.guidanceFallback: Safety guidance is not yet available in your language, so it is shown in English.
result.guidanceSource: General safety guidance. Not medical advice.
result.noneNotified: No service has been notified yet.
result.merged: Your report was added to an existing report of the same emergency nearby.
result.noUpdates: No updates yet. This page refreshes automatically.
result.genaiGuidance: Written by GenAI from approved safety guidance for your situation

evidence.unconscious: Someone may be unconscious or not breathing
evidence.sensor_corroboration: A nearby sensor detected the event
evidence.sensor_severe: The sensor graded the impact, heat or smoke as severe

track.title: Track a report
track.intro: Enter your report number and tracking code.
track.forbidden: The report number or tracking code is wrong.

footer.disclaimer: RESQ.AI supports emergency services. It does not replace calling 112 or official dispatch.

help.title: Help on the way
help.stay: Stay where it is safe and keep your phone on.
